card.name: Crescent and moon-related word endings
card.fires_on: The final piece of 'crescent' (cres|cent), especially before '-shaped'. It also fires on moon-related words such as 'Moon Phases' and 'Phobos', and weakly on the closing parenthesis of a dated article-notice.
